description:
Delete the publish check's handling of a put or delete at the event log, which no redo record can carry.

## Background

`RedoRecord::new` refuses a put or delete at the event log. The publish check still treats either as touching the log (`crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store.rs:925-934`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The publish check decides whether a record touches the event log from its event append alone, and no code path handles a put or delete at the log.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: The publish check's event-log rewrite branch is gone
